name: kit-cutscene
about: LumaKit cutscene (lumakit.md 2.13, lumakit-modules.md row 19). kit-cutscene plays three scenes on EggStarGalaxy. each_shot / run_through: a scene made in code of a Look at the first Kuribo, a Move, an Action (the Kuribo's own 'Walk'), a Wait, a Call and a Line said as a message (A closes it): play gives true, the Call ran once, the camera moved (the main camera's place differs mid-Move from its start by more than 100 units) and is the game's again at the end (within 1 unit of where it would be: the player has not moved), the player's control is back. letterbox: mid-scene MR::isStopCinemaFrame is false while the bars move and the picture 'bars' shows them. skipped: the data scene tour.json started and PLUS held: play gives false within 5 frames, everything put back. actor_dies: a scene of a 600-frame Look at a Kuribo that the mod kills at frame 30 of it: the shot ends early (under 60 frames), the scene runs on and gives true. WAITING: kit.camera (FB: take, aim, end, now), svc.draw.view in the SDK, `sound` as a type and `as?` (K), mods.kit_read binding (K), `on mods.stopped(gone)` beside `use svc.mods` (K).
